description: This Java class, EntityTagValueValidator, validates whether a given CharSequence is a valid EntityTag according to RFC 7232. It throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: EntityTagValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton class that validates if a CharSequence is a valid EntityTag as per RFC 7232. It extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator and overrides validateValue to perform validation.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityTagValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided CharSequence value using EntityTag.isValid. Throws DittoHeaderInvalidException if validation fails.
